checks.title: Instance IRI built under a superseded base
checks.description: A BIND still CONCATs instance IRIs under the base agreed for a class that has since been replaced, typically because the concept moved into a shared namespace and took its agreed IRI pattern with it.
checks.remediation: Update the mapping's BIND to the pattern the superseding class declares, and decide what happens to the identifiers already issued.
checks.cucumber_scenario: Instance IRIs follow the pattern the current model agrees on
